title: Power Posing Embodied Confidence

Drawing from Cuddy's Presence Power Posing framework, Marcus recognizes mind-body disconnect: mental confidence (Francisco accepting introvert validity) not translating to physical confidence—body stuck in anxiety patterns (defensive postures manifesting self-protection) preventing full leadership emergence. The Eight of Swords revealing embodiment truth: anxiety not just mental (thoughts patterns) but physical (body memory)—cognitive work addressing mind incomplete without somatic intervention addressing body. Implementation reveals embodiment advantage: power posing increasing self-assessed confidence 37% pre-post measurements, confidence gains persisting beyond immediate pose moments, peer coaching deepening Francisco's own embodiment (teaching consolidating understanding). Tyrian Purple deepening: confidence requiring not just mental validation but physical embodiment—mind-only partial, body-mind integration complete leadership presence authorities' disembodied cognitive approaches somatically cannot achieve.
